static_inputs.description: Physical sample rate of incoming frequency stream; must equal 1/Player.run_freq_time_step
Rolling window over which the state machine looks for trigger
Window analyzed by Prony AR(p) decomposition after a trigger
Minimum seconds between reported events; raise (e.g. 9999) to treat one long oscillation as a single event
Time window for clustering simultaneous unit detections into one event
Optional ground-truth event list (inline JSON or file path): [{start_time_sec, frequency_hz, amplitude, damping_ratio}, ...]

dynamic_inputs.description: PMU frequency time-series from Player (values interpreted as Hz; one row per HELICS time grant)

dynamic_outputs.description: Detected oscillation events; values carry per-mode frequency_hz, ids carry mode tags
